summary: Bentley Systems filed an 8-K to report entry into a First Amendment and Incremental Facility Agreement amending its existing credit agreement. The amendment adds a $550 million senior secured term loan maturing October 18, 2029, with quarterly amortization of 1.25% starting June 30, 2027. Interest is at Alternate Base Rate or Term SOFR plus a margin based on net leverage ratio. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring was announced; this is a routine financing arrangement.
